prepared_by: compliance-reminder build (Aman, chat 2026-10-09: 'the compliance due dates are the governmentally fixed dates and i need the reminder at least a week before')
how_to_read: Every row is a statutory rule, not a fact about any entity. `source` is the section or rule the date comes from. `applies_to` lists entity kinds; `requires` names the entity flag that must be set (null = every entity of those kinds), `requires_not` a flag that must be clear, `always_for` kinds for which the flag is irrelevant. `extendable: true` means CBDT / CBIC / MCA can shift the date by notification; the bot never assumes an extension. Monthly rows give the day of the month after the period; `overrides` replace the default occurrence for a period month ({months_after, day, period}). Dated rows list {mmdd, period}; placeholders: {fy} = FY of the due date, {fy_prev} = the FY before it, {ay} = assessment year for {fy_prev}, {month} = the period month of a monthly row. `remind_group: false` rows are listed in the calendar but reminded only once an entity carries the flag.
footer: Vimal Agrawal & Co (CA) handles filings; your click only for payments
